title: AndiX Crypto Vlog day 1
description: You can join bitconnect here for free: https://bitconnect.co/?ref=AndixIMA Please excuse my rookie mistakes in front of the camera.

asr.full_text: what is up everyone my name is Andy welcome to my first cryptocurrency video I'm gonna be talking about mostly some investments I'm gonna be doing I'm thinking of producing everyday videos so with any further ado we have two platforms which I'm thinking to sort of start my investment in one is gdax and it's pretty straightforward in gdax you can you can pretty much buy and sell bitcoin without any fees um and um what i've done so far is i've taken uh maybe 12 000 roughly 12000 euros of capital and split it in half between GDAC's and BitConnect. So what BitConnect is if you don't know what it is, it's basically a platform, a lending platform where you can sell your Bitcoin for the BitConnect coin to their website and then if you press here LEND BIT CONNECT you can use that money to lend the platform from a hundred to a hundred thousand dollars. And then you get, based on the Volatility Software Interest, which is this one. You can get some daily interest depending on that. Plus you can also get an extra maybe 0.10 or 0.20 or 0.25% depending on the amount that you make from it. So what I'm thinking to do so far is I've already bought one 1.3 Bitcoin or something like that and then the rest I'm thinking to, well I've already done it actually, I have invested in BitConnect. Now I know a lot of people say that this is a really risky platform and it probably is, but as long as, as long as it is around, why not try to make any advantage of it? Or make any profit from it? Like everybody, like every other YouTuber says... Only invest what you're willing to lose from the platform. And honestly, the payouts have been alright so far. Like if you click here, I've already made but what has it been like ten days I've made like eleven hundred dollars back just from the lending profit and on top of that there's an affiliate bonus so well I don't have any recommended people so far but you can get a link up here on the left and if somebody else gets that link and signs up with it then you get a little commission from it which if you have a lot of people it can accumulate to a big amount of money so these have been these are my two main strategies so far of course if you go to the coin cap, coin market cap you can see there's ton of opportunities of course in so many different altcoins but that I guess what we're gonna talk about in another video on top of everything else we have Bitcoin hitting an all-time high of $8,229 as of this video uploads so I think these are things I want to talk about for my first video feel free to join me this journey I will try to post everyday videos about bit connect and maybe and also about Bitcoin and what I plan to do and how to invest it and everything and hopefully if I managed to get some some profits from it I'll try to do daily giveaways as well. So subscribe for that, and thank you for watching.

evidence.quote: you can sell your Bitcoin for the BitConnect coin to their website and then if you press here LEND BIT CONNECT you can use that money to lend the platform from a hundred to a hundred thousand dollars. And then you get, based on the Volatility Software Interest, which is this one. You can get some daily interest depending on that. Plus you can also get an extra maybe 0.10 or 0.20 or 0.25% depending on the amount that you make from it.

textual.context: The speaker presents this as his own investment activity and says he has already invested in BitConnect; the source also includes a warning that it is risky.
textual.potential_relevance: A promised daily return and additional percentage is directly linked to transferring Bitcoin into a lending platform, creating a reward-and-payment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the stated returns, platform, or investment outcome were genuine, sustainable, or independently verified.

textual.observation: The description directs viewers to join BitConnect through a referral URL, and the speaker states that a person who signs up through his link generates an affiliate commission.

there's an affiliate bonus so well I don't have any recommended people so far but you can get a link up here on the left and if somebody else gets that link and signs up with it then you get a little commission from it which if you have a lot of people it can accumulate to a big amount of money

textual.limitations: The records do not establish the commission amount, signup conditions, whether viewers acted on the link, or whether any payment was received.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes BitConnect lending in exchange for daily interest and an additional percentage while displaying high-return claims and an earnings calculator. He directs viewers to join through his referral URL and explains that signups through it earn him commissions, linking the investment promotion to his recruitment benefit. He acknowledges risk and advises viewers to invest only what they are willing to lose, while the records do not verify the advertised returns or referral payments.
